lessons_used: Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 winning tests (+9.0%, +4.3%, and +4.8% after noise correction), though no clear effect was seen in 4 other tests.
Adding a new screen to adoption was harmful, as both tests agreed on a negative impact after noise correction (-2.5% and -10.4%).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen changes because their tests disagreed after noise correction.
Evidence is still thin for home new_flow and choose_path reorder changes because each has only 1 test.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, particularly for tests that failed or were stopped early.
Predictions were too low for the round 2 finish new_screen test (+8.0% predicted vs +9.8% noise-corrected) and round 8 sign_in reorder test (+0.8% predicted vs +9.0% noise-corrected).

candidates.title: Split Layout Adoption Certificate Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a split layout to highlight official adoption details beside a pet preview card.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate across the funnel at 60.9% and long completion times (mean 1017s).

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your companion's adoption details to prepare them for your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout while retaining key details is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High potential impact due to 39.1% adoption drop-off, but previous adoption redesigns performed poorly (-4.1% average).

candidates.title: Desktop Compatibility Status Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated screen during the home waiting phase that verifies graphics compatibility and desktop overlay status.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not appear on the desktop, and waiting median time is 201s.

new_desktop_status.headline: Verifying Desktop Display Compatibility
new_desktop_status.body: Checking system settings to ensure your desktop companion renders smoothly.

guard.reason: Adding a compatibility verification screen during the waiting phase inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Backed by support emails, but adding new screens during onboarding historically reduced conversion.

candidates.title: Post-Setup Companion Voice and Chat Quick Start
candidates.change: Add interactive voice and chat instruction component on the home_intro screen explaining pet interaction shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3 emails) regarding how to talk to, control, or hide the desktop pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready to Chat!
home_intro.body: Click your pet anytime or press Ctrl+Space to start talking and issuing desktop commands.

guard.reason: Adding interactive shortcut instructions to the home intro overlay is permitted as part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support emails, but introducing new flow steps has shown negative lift in past tests.

candidates.title: Late Sign-In Placement After Pick Friend Stage
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pick_friend so users select their companion before authenticating.
candidates.why: Lessons show sign-in relocation boosted completion in past winning tests (+9.0%), and letting users choose a pet first reduces early drop-off.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in steps has strong historical backing with multiple high-performing winning tests.

candidates.title: Choose Path Selection Helper Hint
candidates.change: Display a helpful hint clarifying that path choices can be altered anytime after onboarding in settings.
candidates.why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean duration of 514s, indicating decision hesitation.

choose_path.hint: You can switch between preset pets and custom photo pet creation anytime in application settings.

guard.reason: Adding helper hints to the path selection screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint targeting high completion time (514s) at choose_path.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time and Progress Estimator
candidates.change: Show live dynamic progress and estimated finish time on the waiting screen while background assets build.
candidates.why: Home wait step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to abandonment due to lack of feedback.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Your companion assets are currently being synthesized and optimized for your monitor.

guard.reason: Showing dynamic progress and estimates during a real waiting period is allowed under rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major home wait time friction (mean 2336s) by providing clear feedback.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Sync Security Incentive Banner
candidates.change: Add a cloud backup verification badge on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in prevents pet loss.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after re-authenticating.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet with Cloud Sync
sign_in.body: Sign in to save your companion profile to the cloud and prevent progress resets.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud backup information badge to the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Top support mail issue (8 emails); low-cost banner reassurance on sign_in.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Upload Clarity Guidance
candidates.change: Update upload_photos screen copy with explicit photo guidelines regarding lighting and framing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: For best generation results, upload well-lit photos facing forward with minimal background blur.

guard.reason: Updating guidance copy on the photo upload screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (adoption) with clear copy guidelines for reported support issues.

candidates.title: Card Layout Path Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Transform the choose_path screen layout into structured cards for companion selection paths.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with an unusually long mean completion time of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Onboarding Path
choose_path.body: Choose whether to adopt a classic companion or upload photos for a custom companion creation.

guard.reason: Redesigning path selection into cards while preserving both adoption choices is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Significant drop-off and duration on choose_path, but layout redesigns lack proven positive historical evidence.

candidates.title: Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is rendered.
candidates.why: Long wait times at home step (mean 2336s) cause users to switch windows and forget to finish setup.

waiting.hint: We will send a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready to appear!

guard.reason: Enabling optional readiness notifications on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users switching away during long background home wait times.
